issues.description: ArrayHelpers method name is inconsistent between the template and the rest of the codebase: the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java) declares a helper named appendElement(T[] array, T element) while the template Stock class and the solution use addElementToArray(T[] array, T element). This naming mismatch causes compilation errors when Stock.addToStockIngredients calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) but the template ArrayHelpers does not provide that symbol. The problem statement also refers students to ArrayHelpers methods (problem_statement.md).
issues.suggestedFix: Restore consistency by providing addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) in the template ArrayHelpers API (preferred), for example by renaming appendElement to addElementToArray or by adding a wrapper method addElementToArray that delegates to the existing method. Alternatively, update all callers (e.g., Stock.addToStockIngredients) to call appendElement, but adding addElementToArray preserves the intended API used in the solution and minimizes changes across files.
